study.question: Observed limitation: useful target-aware history signal (baseline static/pooled/DIN AUC0.6050036/0.6102261/0.6133620) and a seed42 role-routing interaction do not identify shared-row gradient conflict. The own/own, half/own, own/half and half/half cells have AUC0.6149816912/0.6149975213/0.6148160125/0.6151021885, interaction+0.0002703459, while joint-minus-full is only+0.0001204973. Can symmetric projection of negatively aligned query/history product gradients in shared category/brand rows improve validation AUC beyond a same-state product-gradient norm control, and does it reduce the marginal AUC advantage of the rank-half normalization rule?
study.hypothesis: Provisional, not established: opposing product-query and product-history BCE contributions in shared embedding rows impede joint learning; rotating their summed direction by symmetric conflict removal can help beyond changing its magnitude. Under this specific overlap account, projection improves own/full more than its magnitude control, and the half-minus-full AUC gain is smaller with projection than with norm control. Earlier positive performance nonadditivity does not itself measure negative gradient inner products. This is an intervention on the existing single supervised loss, not separate behavior labels, multi-task supervision, or a verified new external algorithm.

study.proposed_difference: Four standalone arms form normalization(full versus rank-half) x shared-row operation(projection versus magnitude control), with existing no-surgery full/half anchors. In each training loss, clone the four exclusive aligned-product operands; obtain mean-BCE gradients at those endpoints using autograd.grad(retain_graph=True). Scatter-add product-query q and product-history h separately into each category/brand table row, excluding padding0 and masked history. For q.h<0 and ||q||^2,||h||^2,||q+h||^2>1e-30, use P=(q-(q.h)/||h||^2*h)+(h-(q.h)/||q||^2*q). Candidate replaces q+h by P. Control replaces it by N=||P||/||q+h||*(q+h). All other rows, including exact opposition, are unchanged. Add detached delta=P-(q+h) or N-(q+h) by the zero-forward scalar term sum(weight*delta)-stop_gradient(sum(weight*delta)), so all unchanged gradients O remain and total table gradient is O+P or O+N. No .grad/Adam mutation or new optimizer. Batch coupling exists only in authorized training gradients, never forward predictions. Two calls0/512 audit actual augmented-loss gradient against total_base+delta and retain only23 aggregate scalars each. First512 validation diagnostics read those cached aggregates and check forward/masking plus six tiny synthetic checks, for59 total scalars. Missing slots call=-1 are unavailable, not zero effects. This is a bounded mechanism intervention and matched control; original nonadditivity mediation and novelty remain unverified.
predictions: Primary directional hypothesis: at frozen seed42, AUC(full_project)-AUC(full_norm_control)>0 if directional conflict removal helps beyond product-row magnitude. Report the half stratum separately and all four outcomes, even if neither improves the incumbent.

Predeclared interaction prediction for the specific overlap account: [AUC(half_project)-AUC(full_project)]-[AUC(half_norm_control)-AUC(full_norm_control)]<0. This is a conditional performance interaction; it is neither the old two-role factorial nor evidence of Adam mediation.

At common training states with nondegenerate role gradients there are some negative-dot rows, nonzero eligible corrections and potentially different projection/control directions. Count active/conflicting/eligible rows and measure norms rather than assuming them. No prediction that half necessarily reduces every conflict count.

Within each state, projected and control product-sum per-row norms match within relative1e-5; recorded actual augmented-loss table gradient matches total_base+delta within relative1e-5, padding correction0 and scalar BCE difference0. Synthetic float64 projection/norm/surrogate checks should have absolute errors<=1e-12. Validation common-state logits differ by<=1e-6, masked mass0 and empty summary0; weight normalization error<=1e-6. These are candidate-authored diagnostics, not independent host proof.

Parameters remain17,130,275 with the actual metadata; all arms process the same examples/epochs, but extra reverse traversal and table aggregation increase compute/memory. No efficiency improvement is predicted; compare measured wall/train time, peak memory, inference throughput and p50/p95 latency where host supplies them. Loss is secondary and can rank differently.
falsifiers: Full_project AUC<=full_norm_control weakens the directional-benefit claim in this one implementation/seed. A nonnegative specified interaction weakens the particular overlap account. Negative/null outcomes are retained and do not refute all gradient-conflict mechanisms.

No eligible conflict, negligible correction/direction difference, or dominance by excluded degenerate rows makes the intervention nondiscriminating; do not reinterpret a null as a successful test of absent conflict.

Unexpected forward/BCE, parameter initialization, source configuration, gradient-isolation, mask/padding or scalar-injection discrepancy beyond predeclared tolerances suspends attribution. Record failures and their charged costs; do not silently repair a frozen executed arm or tune thresholds after feedback.

Absent norm matching or actual-gradient residual>1e-5 invalidates the intended directional contrast until a separately planned source correction is justified. Positive AUC alone cannot rescue failed manipulation checks.

Even positive results cannot prove the original rank-half improvement is mediated by cancellation: unchanged-path geometry, Adam state, batch/hash collisions, checkpoint selection and adaptive seed42 reuse remain alternatives. No robust superiority, action/time semantics, user-cluster significance or literature novelty follows.
